{{Term/Store|Guardian Scout IV|Guardian Scouts IV|Series, BotW|plural}} are [[Enemy|Enemies]] in {{BotW}}.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium"/>

==Characteristics==
{{Compendium/Extract|Guardian Scout IV}}
The Guardian Scout IV is the strongest variation of the [[Guardian Scout]], found within "A Major Test of Strength" [[Ancient Shrine]]s. In order to complete these shrines, [[Link]] must defeat the Guardian Scouts IV inside. Being the most upgraded versions, Guardian Scouts IV are capable of wielding three weapons at once.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/> They are equipped with any combination of a [[Guardian Sword++]], [[Guardian Shield++]], [[Guardian Spear++]], or [[Ancient Battle Axe++]].
